\begin{table*}[t]
\caption{Sensitivity of the single-sounding threshold $M_{\min}^{(3\sigma)}$ at $z=20$~km (heritage triplet, the six background parameters free, silica amplitude fitted, calibrated undisturbed background) for the $7.8$--$13~\mu$m band at $0.1~\mu$m sampling and for its $7.8$--$9.3~\mu$m window subset. ``Adopted'' is the joint retrieval under the measurement model of Table~\ref{tab:error_budget} (baselines $0.119$ and $0.168$~Tg); ``scenario'' is the diagonal-floor scenario of that table (baselines $0.101$ and $0.141$~Tg), in which the scans of Appendix~\ref{app:sensitivity} were made. In the adopted column the rows that scale the floors scale the discrepancy term (all three mid-infrared terms in parentheses), the constant offset and the exponential correlation are the scenarios of Table~\ref{tab:error_budget}, the element-width row is not repeated (no measured scatter exists at $0.05~\mu$m), and the vertically coherent database row is superseded by the multi-tangent retrieval of Appendix~\ref{app:tracegas_geometry}. The altitude rows carry the discrepancy term constant with altitude (scaled by the measured $16$--$19$ and $22$--$25$-km bins of Appendix~\ref{app:acefloor} in parentheses).}
\label{tab:robust_summary}
\centering
\footnotesize
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{4pt}
\begin{adjustbox}{max width=\textwidth}
\begin{tabular}{p{7.0cm}cccc}
\toprule
Perturbation & \multicolumn{2}{c}{Adopted model [Tg]} & \multicolumn{2}{c}{Scenario [Tg]} \\
 & Band & Window & Band & Window \\
\midrule
Baseline & 0.119 & 0.168 & $0.101$ & $0.141$ \\
\midrule
Sulfate microphysics: post--Hunga Tonga calibration & 0.119 & 0.186 & $0.100$ & $0.146$ \\
Sulfate member optics: Biermann $70$~wt\,\%, $215$~K & 0.119 & 0.172 & $0.103$ & $0.143$ \\
Constant offset common to all MIR elements, free & 0.119 & 0.217 & $0.102$ & $0.26$ \\
Uniform floors (adopted: discrepancy term at the $8.80$-$\mu$m level everywhere) & 0.107 & 0.148 & $0.083$ & $0.113$ \\
MIR floors $\times2$ / $\times0.5$ (adopted: discrepancy term; all terms in parentheses) & 0.196 / 0.080 (0.215 / 0.070) & 0.261 / 0.123 (0.276 / 0.113) & $0.202$ / $0.051$ & $0.282$ / $0.071$ \\
Database line-intensity term vertically coherent (Sect.~\ref{sec:dz_scaling}; adopted: Appendix~\ref{app:tracegas_geometry}) & -- & -- & $0.078$ & $0.109$ \\
Floors exponentially correlated, $\ell=0.1$ / $0.25~\mu$m (independent in parentheses) & 0.126 / 0.113 (0.123) & 0.172 / 0.154 (0.174) & $0.124$ / $0.107$ ($0.108$) & $0.159$ / $0.131$ ($0.150$) \\
Background loading $\mathrm{SAOD}_{525}=0.003$--$0.010$ & 0.118--0.119 & 0.167--0.168 & $0.101$--$0.101$ & $0.141$--$0.141$ \\
Element width $0.05$ / $0.25~\mu$m & -- & -- & $0.079$ / $0.176$ & $0.108$ / $0.279$ \\

Enlarged background family: second optics member (Biermann) as a free amplitude (eight aerosol parameters\ClaudeText{, $47$ in the joint state}) & 0.133 & 0.191 & $0.128$ & $0.220$ \\
\midrule
Silica PSD width $\sigma_\text{psd}=1.5$ / $1.8$ & 0.130 / 0.202 & 0.180 / 0.273 & $0.107$ / $0.143$ & $0.156$ / $0.244$ \\
Silica $r_\text{med}=150$ / $600$~nm & 0.120 / 0.183 & 0.173 / 0.238 & $0.102$ / $0.128$ & $0.140$ / $0.219$ \\
Silica optics: \citet{Franta2016} & 0.138 & 0.208 & $0.109$ & $0.150$ \\

Reststrahlen peak, $r_\text{med}=150\to600$~nm & \multicolumn{4}{l}{$8.79\to8.84~\mu$m} \\
\midrule
Visible/NIR noise $\times0.5$ / $\times4$ & 0.119 / 0.119 & 0.168 / 0.168 & $0.101$ / $0.102$ & $0.141$ / $0.141$ \\
Altitude $16$ / $24$~km & 0.076 / 0.205 (0.170 / 0.155) & 0.116 / 0.258 (0.231 / 0.200) & $0.056$ / $0.146$ & $0.078$ / $0.204$ \\
